description.value: Obsession Bikes is a full-service bicycle shop on the North Vancouver waterfront, stocking a broad range of mountain, road, gravel, hybrid, and eBikes alongside a deep selection of components and accessories. The shop operates a dedicated service department with online booking and advertises a 24-hour turnaround on repairs. Touring cyclists will find panniers, racks, fenders, frame bags, hydration gear, and locks all under one roof.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and current (banner references 'June 3 — 24 hour turnaround' consistent with the current date), confirming the business is open. OSM tags repair=yes, service:bicycle:repair=yes, and service:bicycle:ebike=yes are corroborated by the website's dedicated service booking page and full eBike product/service offerings. The website navigation reveals panniers, racks, fenders, and frame bags are stocked, supporting touring parts; no explicit evidence for pump, walk-in policy, washrooms, or other facility amenities was found in the retrieved content.
concerns: Contact page content was truncated before phone number or address could be confirmed from the website; phone and address contact_confirmed left null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active full-service bicycle shop with a live website and confirmed repair services — clearly useful to touring cyclists.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Website navigation lists pannier bags, handlebar & frame bags, saddle bags, front and rear racks, fenders, locks, and hydration — all core touring categories

E-bike service.detail: Website carries full eBike line (eMountain, eRoad, eGravel, eHybrid, eCargo) and the service page covers all bike types

wow_evidence: panniers, racks, fenders, frame bags, hydration gear, and locks all under one roof
